title: What Northside Yoga's members are saying

0.label: Hot room too hot
0.summary: Members say the hot room has run dangerously hot (one saw 108 and got dizzy), and even after the thermostat fix it still feels stuffy and humid.
0.action: Set a fixed target temperature with a posted thermostat check before each hot class, and add a fan or dehumidifier for airflow.

1.label: More classes with Maya
1.summary: Maya is the main reason many members joined and stay, and her classes fill so fast that people want more of them.
1.action: Add one more Maya class in a popular slot, and ask Maya what would keep her happy here long term.

2.label: Happy, nothing to change
2.summary: Many members would change nothing and credit the community and the teachers with keeping them coming back.
2.action: Ask these happy members for reviews or referrals, and quote their words in your marketing.

3.label: Dirty shared mats
3.summary: Rental mats and blocks smell or have hair and sweat on them, and the cleaning spray and towels often run out.
3.action: Add a 'used mats' bin, clean rental mats every day, and keep spray and towels stocked at every rack.

4.label: Prices too high vs ClassPass
4.summary: Members feel $165 unlimited and $30 drop-ins are steep next to ClassPass, and some want longer class pack expiry or student and teacher discounts.
4.action: Extend the 10-class pack expiry to 6 months and trial a student and teacher discount.

5.label: Music too loud
5.summary: Music in flow and barre classes drowns out the teacher's cues and savasana, and barre can be heard through the wall in the other room.
5.action: Set a maximum music volume for every class, keep savasana quiet, and look at soundproofing the shared wall.

6.label: Parking and bike racks
6.summary: Street parking on Mississippi is full for evening classes and the two bike racks are always taken.
6.action: Add more bike racks out front, and ask the church lot on Shaver about evening parking.

7.label: Touched without asking
7.summary: Members report teachers, especially newer ones and subs, giving hands-on adjustments without consent, including one injury blamed on Brandon; one comment about barre modifications is mixed in.
7.action: Introduce consent cards, train all teachers and subs to ask before touching, and follow up personally with the injured member.

8.label: Gentle, senior and family classes
8.summary: Members ask for gentle or chair classes for older people, kids and parent-baby classes, and prenatal yoga; a few also miss early weekday mornings.
8.action: Pilot one weekly gentle or chair class for 60+ members and see how many sign up.

9.label: Barre too hard for beginners
9.summary: New members find regular barre fast and intimidating and want a slower beginner version or an intro series.
9.action: Start a 4-week Barre Basics series and add a barre orientation to the intro month.

10.label: Unfair late cancel fees
10.summary: Members are charged late cancel fees when the app fails to cancel or miscounts the window, and many find the 12-hour policy harsh; one complaint appears twice.
10.action: Refund the fees members can show were app errors, and allow one free sick-day waiver per month.

11.label: Bring back 6am classes
11.summary: Commuters are upset that the new schedule cut the 6am flow and barre, and some threaten to cancel; one comment about the slow 6pm check-in line is mixed in.
11.action: Bring back at least one 6am flow and one 6am barre class before November.

12.label: Childcare during classes
12.summary: Parents say they barely use or have paused their memberships because there is no childcare, and some would pay for a sitter.
12.action: Trial a paid lobby sitter for the Saturday 9am class at about $5 per kid.

13.label: Cramped wet locker room
13.summary: The locker room is cramped and the floor is often wet, and there are not enough working lockers, hooks or benches; one request for a refilled water station is mixed in.
13.action: Put down non-slip mats, fix the locks, add hooks and benches, and add the water station to the daily checklist.

14.label: Booking app crashes
14.summary: The booking app crashes, logs members out and double-books them, and they lose spots in classes as a result.
14.action: Report these bugs to the booking software vendor, or compare alternatives before the next contract renewal.

15.label: More class time options
15.summary: Members want classes before 7am, later in the evening, and on Saturday afternoons; one also asks teachers to start classes on time.
15.action: Add one 8pm class and one Saturday afternoon class, and ask teachers to start on the minute.

16.label: Prenatal and postnatal classes
16.summary: Pregnant members and new parents want a weekly prenatal class and a postnatal class so they can keep their membership; one asks for a teacher training program.
16.action: Launch a weekly prenatal class taught by a certified teacher, and promote it as the only one nearby.

17.label: More weekend classes
17.summary: Saturday and Sunday classes fill days ahead, and members want more weekend time slots.
17.action: Add a second Saturday morning class next to the 9am.

18.label: Weekend waitlist frustrations
18.summary: Members on unlimited plans rarely get off weekend waitlists, and the auto-add rule charges them on only an hour's notice.
18.action: Stop charging people who are auto-added from the waitlist less than a few hours before class.
